page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-24-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance featuring 24 dedicated vCPUs and 90.0 GB of system memory, yielding 3.75 GB of RAM per core. This instance includes integrated local storage consisting of four NVMe SSDs with a combined capacity of 1611 GB. No GPU accelerators are included in this hardware profile, and it does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The inclusion of 1611 GB of local NVMe SSD storage directly attached to the instance provides high-throughput, low-latency local disk access. This bundled storage configuration offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring high-density local scratch space or active database caching, as it eliminates the need for external block storage provisioning. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from neighboring tenants.

Given the balance of 24 dedicated vCPUs, 90.0 GB of RAM, and substantial local NVMe SSD storage, this server is configured for database hosting, local data processing, and IOPS-intensive workloads. It is also suitable for containerized applications, web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications that require a combination of dedicated compute resources and fast local storage.
